title: Molding, Coremaking, and Casting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
description: Set up, operate, or tend metal or plastic molding, casting, or coremaking machines to mold or cast metal or thermoplastic parts or products.

tasks.text: Measure and visually inspect products for surface and dimension defects to ensure conformance to specifications, using precision measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Inspect metal, plastic, or composite products.
Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Observe continuous operation of automatic machines to ensure that products meet specifications and to detect jams or malfunctions, making adjustments as necessary.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical product flaw monitoring is on-machine

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure that products are not flawed.

tasks.text: Set up, operate, or tend metal or plastic molding, casting, or coremaking machines to mold or cast metal or thermoplastic parts or products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Turn valves and dials of machines to regulate pressure, temperature, and speed and feed rates, and to set cycle times.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Read specifications, blueprints, and work orders to determine setups, temperatures, and time settings required to mold, form, or cast plastic materials, as well as to plan production sequences.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprint setup reading partial, human confirms

dwas.name: Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Observe meters and gauges to verify and record temperatures, pressures, and press-cycle times.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.

tasks.text: Connect water hoses to cooling systems of dies, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting supply lines is physical fitting

dwas.name: Connect supply lines to production equipment or tools.

tasks.text: Remove parts, such as dies, from machines after production runs are finished.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing parts from equipment is hands-on

dwas.name: Remove accessories, tools, or other parts from equipment.

tasks.text: Perform maintenance work such as cleaning and oiling machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Maintain production or processing equipment.
Lubricate production equipment.

tasks.text: Smooth and clean inner surfaces of molds, using brushes, scrapers, air hoses, or grinding wheels, and fill imperfections with refractory material.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand finishing of metal edges with tools

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Smooth metal surfaces or edges.
Fill cracks, imperfections, or holes in products or workpieces.

tasks.text: Operate hoists to position dies or patterns on foundry floors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Cool products after processing to prevent distortion.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual application of lubricants to workpieces

dwas.name: Apply lubricants or coolants to workpieces.

tasks.text: Install dies onto machines or presses and coat dies with parting agents, according to work order specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying finishes requires hands-on coating work

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.

tasks.text: Unload finished products from conveyor belts, pack them in containers, and place containers in warehouses.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.
Package products for storage or shipment.

tasks.text: Remove finished or cured products from dies or molds, using hand tools, air hoses, and other equipment, stamping identifying information on products when necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.
Remove workpieces from molds.

tasks.text: Obtain and move specified patterns to work stations, manually or using hoists, and secure patterns to machines, using wrenches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical moving of products between work areas

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.
Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Select and install blades, tools, or other attachments for each operation.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.
Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Repair or replace damaged molds, pipes, belts, chains, or other equipment, using hand tools, hand-powered presses, or jib cranes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual shaping and fitting of physical templates and molds

dwas.name: Repair templates, patterns, or molds.
Replace worn equipment components.

tasks.text: Inventory and record quantities of materials and finished products, requisitioning additional supplies as necessary.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.
Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Select coolants and lubricants, and start their flow.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

dwas.name: Select production input materials.
Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Adjust equipment and workpiece holding fixtures, such as mold frames, tubs, and cutting tables, to ensure proper functioning.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual fixture adjustment

dwas.name: Set equipment guides, stops, spacers, or other fixtures.

tasks.text: Maintain inventories of materials.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Position and secure workpieces on machines, and start feeding mechanisms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Trim excess material from parts, using knives, and grind scrap plastic into powder for reuse.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Mix and measure compounds, or weigh premixed compounds, and dump them into machine tubs, cavities, or molds.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical mixing of chemical solutions

dwas.name: Mix substances to create chemical solutions.
Load materials into production equipment.

tasks.text: Spray, smoke, or coat molds with compounds to lubricate or insulate molds, using acetylene torches or sprayers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying parting agents is manual mold prep

dwas.name: Apply parting agents or other solutions to molds.

tasks.text: Preheat tools, dies, plastic materials, or patterns, using blowtorches or other equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Heating workpieces requires physical operation

dwas.name: Heat material or workpieces to prepare for or complete production.

tasks.text: Pour or load metal or sand into melting pots, furnaces, molds, or hoppers, using shovels, ladles, or machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual placement of materials into molds

dwas.name: Place materials into molds.
Load materials into production equipment.
Load items into ovens or furnaces.

tasks.text: Skim or pour dross, slag, or impurities from molten metal, using ladles, rakes, hoes, spatulas, or spoons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Skimming molten metal, hazardous manual task

dwas.name: Skim impurities from molten metal.
